title.narrative: Human Resources Support Services to UNEP Cartagena Convention Secretariat

description.narrative: The Convention for the Protection and Development of the Marine Environment of the Wider Caribbean Region (WCR) or Cartagena Convention is a regional legal agreement for the protection of the Caribbean Sea. The Convention was adopted in Cartagena, Colombia on 24 March 1983 and entered into force on 11 October 1986 and is supported by three technical agreements or Protocols on Oil Spills, Specially Protected Areas and Wildlife (SPAW) and Land Based Sources of Marine Pollution (LBS).\n\nUNOPS supports the secretariat of the Cartagena Convention through human resources support.
